from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    col, lower, trim, regexp_replace, to_timestamp, to_date,
    year, month, dayofmonth, hour, length
)
from pyspark.sql.types import StringType
 
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("BronzeToSilver").getOrCreate()
 
df_raw = (
    spark.read
    .option("recursiveFileLookup", "true")
    .parquet("abfss://dlfs5clou-raw@dl5clou.dfs.core.windows.net/")
)
 
# -----------------------------
# 1. Standardisation du schéma
# -----------------------------
df = (
    df_raw
    .withColumn("id", col("id").cast("string"))
    .withColumn("account_id", col("account_id").cast("string"))
    .withColumn("content", col("content").cast(StringType()))
    .withColumn("created_at", to_timestamp("created_at"))
)
 
# -----------------------------
# 2. Nettoyage & Qualité
# -----------------------------
df = (
    df
    .dropDuplicates(["id"])                                      
    .filter(col("content").isNotNull() & (length(col("content")) > 0))
)
 
# -----------------------------
# 3. Nettoyage avancé du texte
# -----------------------------
df = (
    df
    .withColumn("content", trim(col("content")))
    .withColumn("content", regexp_replace("content", r"<[^>]+>", ""))  # supprime HTML
    .withColumn("content", regexp_replace("content", r"[^\x00-\x7F]+", ""))  # supprime emojis
    .withColumn("content", regexp_replace("content", r'[\s]+', " "))   # espace unique
    .withColumn("content_clean", lower(col("content")))
    .withColumn("content_length", length(col("content_clean")))
)
 
# -----------------------------
# 4. Enrichissement
# -----------------------------
df = (
    df
    .withColumn("event_date", to_date(col("created_at")))
    .withColumn("year", year(col("created_at")))
    .withColumn("month", month(col("created_at")))
    .withColumn("day", dayofmonth(col("created_at")))
    .withColumn("hour", hour(col("created_at")))
)
 
# -----------------------------
# 5. Écriture Silver
# -----------------------------
(
    df.write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .parquet("abfss://dlfs5clou-clean@dl5clou.dfs.core.windows.net/clean/")
